newsitem.title: SWEDEN: La Redoute buys Swedish mail order group Ellos.
newsitem.headline: La Redoute buys Swedish mail order group Ellos.

text.p: French mail order firm La Redoute, a subsidiary of the Pinault-Printemps-Redoute group, bought Swedish mail order company Ellos Gruppen AB, its main owner Industri Kapital said on Tuesday.
Industri Kapital said in a statement that Ellos' Swedish operations would continue as usual.
Industri Kapital owns 71 percent of Ellos, retail food chain Ica Handlarnas AB owns 25 percent and the management of Ellos owns four percent.
Ellos' mail order operations turnover will total about 3.2 billion crowns this year and the company has more than 1,400 employees, Industri Kapital said.

"La Redoute is acquiring Industri Kapital's stake as well as that belonging to the management of Ellos. Ica Handlarnas AB will remain as an owner with an option to sell its stake to La Redoute," Industri Kapital said.
